metadata.description: Approved departure labels for members whose 2025-26 service ends at the January 2027 rollover, plus members who move to the other chamber. Display text states only the fact and date. Placement (rollover decision D6): former members' index and pages; a member who stays in the General Assembly after winning another seat shows the label on their own page (decided 2026-11-21). Keyed by legisGaGovId. Entries without a batch field are batch 1.

pending: 81 (Mike Cheokas, House 151): December 1, 2026 general election runoff

metadata.liveDisplay: Shown on a sitting member's own live page until termEnds (D6, decided 2026-11-23), then retired automatically; former-member pages are separate.
